major_cooldowns.name: Thunder Focus Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Off the global cooldown and castable through a Soothing Mist channel: spend it on Renewing Mist for the 10 second HoT extension and the Secret Infusion haste, on Enveloping Mist when one target needs a large instant heal, or on Rising Sun Kick for the 9 second cooldown cut and Versatility during a defensive moment.

major_cooldowns.name: Life Cocoon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Instant, off the global cooldown, and it will not break Soothing Mist on the same target: drop the 12 second absorb on anyone about to die, since it also raises their healing over time received by 50%.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Ramp into the damage event: get the Secret Infusion haste buff up and spend all Renewing Mist charges first, then summon Yu'lon and rotate Enveloping Mists across the raid, pressing Rising Sun Kick after 3-4 of them to extend the HoTs and filling with Vivify.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The mana-friendly raid cooldown: open it with a Blackout Kick to spend the 4 Teachings of the Monastery stacks into as many targets as possible, then weave Enveloping Mists ahead of incoming damage and extend them with Rising Sun Kick.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Conduit of the Celestials burst window: hold the 4 second channel for a known raid damage spike and recast it through Unity Within to bring every August Celestial in at 200% effectiveness.

major_cooldowns.name: Revival
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: A 40 yard raid-wide heal that also procs Mastery: Gust of Mists on everyone it hits and strips Magic, Poison and Disease, so save it for a stacked damage event or for a raid-wide dispel.

major_cooldowns.name: Restoral
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take this over Revival when a Magic dispel would wipe the raid: the same raid-wide heal without the Magic cleanse, and it stays castable while stunned.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Turns your skin to stone for 15 seconds: press it before a large hit aimed at you or through a stretch of unavoidable raid damage.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Cheap instant self-heal on a short cooldown: press it whenever you have been chipped down and no ally needs the global.

rules.description: Thunder Focus Tea spent on Renewing Mist
rules.action: Follow almost every Thunder Focus Tea with Renewing Mist for the 10 second duration extension and the Secret Infusion haste; only spend it on Enveloping Mist when one target needs the instant burst heal.

rules.description: Blackout Kick right after Invoke Chi-Ji
rules.action: Chi-Ji hands you 4 Teachings of the Monastery stacks, so open the summon with a Blackout Kick into as many targets as you can reach before doing anything else.

rules.description: Enveloping Mist chained inside Invoke Yu'lon
rules.action: Yu'lon cuts Enveloping Mist cast time by 30%, so rotate Enveloping Mists across the raid the moment it lands, then Rising Sun Kick after 3-4 of them to extend every HoT.

rules.description: Strength of the Black Ox into Enveloping Mist
rules.action: Spend every Strength of the Black Ox on an Enveloping Mist: it halves the cast time and shields 5 nearby allies.
Keep Renewing Mist rolling at all times and never sit on 3 charges; it drives your Mastery procs, your tier bonus and your Rising Sun Kick extensions.

rules.description: Spinning Crane Kick on 4 or more enemies
rules.action: Save Spinning Crane Kick for 4 or more enemies, where Way of the Crane turns it into the bulk of your throughput; on fewer targets use Tiger Palm into Blackout Kick instead.

source_summary: Mistweaver plays a reactive priority built on rolling Renewing Mist and never capping its charges, with Thunder Focus Tea going out on Renewing Mist most of the time for the duration extension and the Secret Infusion haste. Raid cooldowns are ramps rather than on-cooldown presses: buff haste and dump Renewing Mist charges before the damage, then pop Invoke Yu'lon and chain Enveloping Mists into a Rising Sun Kick extension, or use Invoke Chi-Ji opened by a Blackout Kick when mana matters more. Revival or Restoral covers a stacked spike or a raid-wide dispel, while Life Cocoon is the off-global answer to a single player about to die.
